notes: Both builds publish the same page from here. The Play build was held at 80.6.12 while the other one moved ahead, and it catches up at this version with every note in this list that belongs to it.
Nothing on the page itself changed in this release: no layout, no colour, no behaviour, so what is new to a Play install is everything in this list, not something on top of it.
Each build updates to itself: the Play bundle carries its own flag, so a catch-up can never hand a Play install the other build’s page.
Nothing changed for this build since 80.6.29 either - the dock tab is still one Library pill, and the side rail is still yours to set in Tools.
